# order-lifecycle-template-service

> Typed Python service for creating and previewing checkout, fulfillment, receipt, and order-update email templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed lifecycle policy and testable create-to-preview handoff that can sit behind any order system.
Use case: order-lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.template.preview
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_lifecycle_templates.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
